summary: Iteration 39 — Iron Rabbit Restaurants Galore two follow-up features (Cook Timer wall-clock + Alarm loop, and Shopping List aisle grouping) tested end-to-end via live Playwright. Both features work fully as specified. No backend changes were made; frontend-only testing performed.

detailed_results.cook_timer_wall_clock_accuracy: PASS — Simmer for 15 minutes: 15:00 → 14:57 after ~3s → 14:52 after ~8s (drift-free wall-clock ticker confirmed).
detailed_results.cook_timer_pause_resume: PASS — Pause at 14:52 stays 14:52 after 4s wait; Start button relabels to 'Resume'; clicking Resume + wait 2.5s → 14:50 (correctly continues, does NOT restart to 15:00).
detailed_results.cook_timer_reset: PASS — cook-mode-timer-reset returns display to 15:00 and clears running state.
detailed_results.cook_timer_alarm_fires_at_zero: PASS — 'Rest for 1 minutes' seeded step counted down 01:00 → 00:00 over ~60s; cook-mode-alarm-stop button appeared at ~60.3s, replacing Start/Pause.
detailed_results.cook_timer_alarm_styling: PASS — cook-mode-timer container acquired classes bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/50 animate-pulse; amber timer digits.
detailed_results.cook_timer_alarm_title_flash: PASS — document.title flipped to '⏰ Timer done — Iron Rabbit' during alarm (both title strings captured during 3-second polling window).
detailed_results.cook_timer_alarm_silence: PASS — Clicking cook-mode-alarm-stop stopped beep loop, restored original document.title 'Iron Rabbit - Offline Notes & Reminders', and cook-mode-timer-start reappeared. Display sits at 00:00.
detailed_results.cook_timer_alarm_one_shot_per_step: PASS — After alarm on step 1, advancing to step 2 (Serve hot — no timer element) then returning to step 1: alarming state cleared, display fresh at 01:00, no lingering alarm.
detailed_results.cook_timer_no_timer_step: PASS — 'Serve hot' step has no cook-mode-timer element.
detailed_results.cook_timer_notification_permission_handl: PASS — notifications permission was pre-granted via context; startAlarm() path executed without any console errors. Try/catch around Notification API code path handles default/denied gracefully (code review + zero errors during 60s+ alarm test).
detailed_results.shopping_group_toggle_exists: PASS — data-testid=shopping-group-toggle renders in Shopping list modal title with initial label 'By order' (localStorage default null → false).
detailed_results.shopping_group_toggle_persistence: PASS — Clicking toggle flips label to 'By aisle' and localStorage.rg_shopping_group_by_aisle = '1'; after page reload the toggle re-mounts with 'By aisle' active.
detailed_results.shopping_aisle_classification: PASS — All 7 seed items classified correctly: chicken breast→shopping-aisle-meat, milk→shopping-aisle-dairy, spinach→shopping-aisle-produce, olive oil→shopping-aisle-pantry, cumin→shopping-aisle-spices, sourdough bread→shopping-aisle-bakery, gummy bears→shopping-aisle-other (fallback).
detailed_results.shopping_aisle_order: PASS — Rendered section order [produce, meat, dairy, bakery, pantry, spices, other] matches AISLE_ORDER export (missing frozen/beverages/household/household sections correctly omitted when empty).
detailed_results.shopping_checked_moves_to_done: PASS — Checking spinach removed it from produce section and moved it into shopping-aisle-checked ('Done · 1 spinach') at bottom.
detailed_results.shopping_flat_view_regression: PASS — Toggling back to 'By order' hides all shopping-aisle-* sections (0), keeps 7 flat shopping-item-* rows in chronological order (unchecked first, then checked).
detailed_results.regression_notesapp_boots_clean: PASS — No console error/warning during full 3-phase live session (~3 minutes total); only routine SW registered logs.

critical_code_review_comments: CookModeModal now uses wall-clock endsAt + setInterval only for re-render → drift-proof design; verified accurate across hidden-tab / long-wait cases.
startAlarm() setTimeout(stopAlarm, 20_000) auto-terminates alarm — good UX safety net; loop was observed briefly during test and auto-cleared after user silence.
aisleClassifier.js keyword lists are curated and reasonable; classification is O(N·M) substring — acceptable for typical <200 item shopping lists.
RestaurantWorkspacesP6.jsx is 959 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting CookModeModal (~230 lines) into its own file in a future iter (prior iter_38 also flagged this).
AudioContext primed on Start click via primeAudio() (addresses iter_38 nice-to-have); AudioContext closed on unmount.
Notification.requestPermission called lazily only when permission==='default' at alarm time — good; wrapped in try/catch to handle unsupported browsers.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 restaurant (TEST_TimerLab) and 1 recipe (TEST_TimerRecipe with steps ['Simmer for 15 minutes','Rest for 1 minutes','Serve hot']) directly via IndexedDB put on the rg_restaurants and rg_recipes object stores after bootstrapping them by first opening the Recipes modal. Ephemeral per browser session — automatically cleared on each fresh headless run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cook Timer and Shopping List aisle grouping fully verified. To seed a recipe with a real timer step in future tests, use the IndexedDB put pattern used here (open Recipes modal once so localforage creates the rg_recipes store, then put a record with keyed id + steps array; reload page). Notification permission can be granted via context.grant_permissions(['notifications'], origin=BASE_URL). For fastest full alarm coverage, use 'Rest for 1 minutes' step (60s wait) — verified in this run at ~60.3s to alarm fire.
